blocks.text: Ready to build the profitable and peaceful salon or spa that is calling your name?Most owners start with a big and beautiful dream. Soon exhaustion, fear and financial woes overtake all emotions. The glimmers of joy often feel like a pretense, as you row the boat alone. Your family, your free time and your well-being all suffer. There is a proven system of success! This book gives you the step-by-step formula of how to reduce your stress while you maximize your profits.

With over 4 decades of building multi-million-dollar award winning beauty businesses, international speaker, business growth coach and best-selling author, Dorothy Andreas, shares every aspect of what you will need to turn your dream into a profitable and peaceful business.

In Build a Million Dollar Beauty Business, you'll discover how to:Get started or make rapid improvements in your existing businessOvercome obstacles and develop new levels of confidenceGet funding for a properly structured business entityAttract, interview, hire, train staff and create an exceptional cultureImplement marketing and sales strategiesBalance family and workOvercome your mindset limitations, build future wealth, and create a legacy
At the end of each chapter, you will find thoughtful questions. As you answer, you are actually building your own roadmap to success. The concepts in this book have been proven in Dorothy’s own businesses, as well as her private and group coaching clients, who quickly scale to the million dollar mark and beyond.
Discover the secrets to success from a mentor with a proven track record in the beauty services industry.

Award Finalist - Business & Money
Build A Million Dollar Beauty Business was a Finalist at the 2024 Global Book Awards in the Business & Money category.   Read more
